title: CaseForge firm profile
description: One firm's identity and layout: names, domains, folder books, storage roots, vault name, hostnames and the firm details court forms print. Never secrets: a vault is named here, its values stay in the vault.

profile_version.description: Schema version this profile is written against.

firm_name.description: The firm's full trading name, as it appears on letters and envelopes.

mail_domains.description: Domains the firm's own mailboxes send from; mail from these is internal.

web_domains.description: Domains the firm's web apps and signing service are served on.

workers.description: First names of the firm's people, in display order.

legal_aid_worker.description: The worker (one of workers) who asks the Legal Aid Agency for a client's means link.

folder_books.description: Top-level matter folders (books) under library_root that hold live client matters.

worker_books.description: Each worker's own book: worker first name (one of workers) to the folder book (one of folder_books) their clients' folders sit directly in, in display order.

shared_books.description: Folder books (each one of folder_books) that nobody owns: a client in one is assigned to no one by that fact. May be empty.

auto_books.description: Workers (each a key of worker_books) whose own books the auto scan watches. May be empty.

casework_books.description: Workers (each a key of worker_books) whose own book is a casework root that mail is filed against: mail filed there carries the worker's name. May be empty.

library_root.description: Path of the live client-files library inside the drive, relative to its root, with no leading or trailing slash.

closed_library_root.description: Path of the closed client-files library, in the same form as library_root.

onedrive_root_name.description: Name of the synced OneDrive/SharePoint root folder on a desktop.

sharepoint_site_id.description: Graph site id of the SharePoint site holding the library: host,site-guid,web-guid.

key_vault_name.description: Azure Key Vault name (not URL) holding the deployment's secrets.

access_team_domain.description: Cloudflare Access team domain that signs the apps' identity tokens.

hostnames.description: Public hostnames of the firm's apps.

legal_rep_name.description: The legal representative named on court forms (FL401 2.11).

legal_rep_firm.description: The firm's name as court forms print it in the representative block (FL401 2.12).

legal_rep_address_line2.description: Firm address: second line, or empty.

legal_rep_postcode.description: Firm address: postcode. A form whose postcode box takes seven characters gets it without the space.

legal_rep_dx.description: The firm's DX number, or empty.

pba_number.description: The firm's court-fee Payment by Account (PBA) number, as it is quoted to the court, or empty when the firm has none.

statement_of_truth_signer.description: Full name of the person who signs the statement of truth for the applicant.

statement_of_truth_firm.description: The firm's name as the statement of truth prints it.

statement_of_truth_position.description: The signer's position or office held.

firm_short_name.description: The short form of the firm's name used in running prose, such as model prompts.

protective_orders_book.description: The folder book (one of folder_books) that holds protective-order matters.

local_model_url.description: Base URL of the self-hosted llama.cpp server, scheme, host and optional port, with no trailing slash.

backup_folder.description: Drive folder that nightly backups upload to, relative to the drive root, with no leading or trailing slash.

common_documents_book.description: Top-level folder under library_root holding the stock documents copied into client folders.

unsorted_attendance_book.description: Top-level folder under library_root for attendance notes whose client has no notes folder yet.

office_street.description: Office address as letters and statements write it in running text: building and street, in ordinary case.

office_town.description: Office address: town or city, in ordinary case.

office_postcode.description: Office address: postcode, with its space.

email_heading.description: The heading printed at the top of an email rendered to PDF for the file.
